Heavy Rains Cause Disruptions and Warnings Across India

Heavy rainfall has led to disruptions and advisories across several Indian states. In Kerala, educational institutions in eight districts were closed on August 7 due to heavy rain warnings, while the Kakkayam dam spillway gates were closed as water inflow declined. Bhubaneswar, Odisha, experienced inundation in parts of the city, with a warning issued for Mayurbhanj. Gurugram, Haryana, saw traffic advisories issued by police, recommending work from home due to intense showers. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued alerts regarding monsoon activity.
